test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair does **not** belong to that group?

(Note: The odd letter-cluster pair is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/520e6a52e2a00bf0e2bf612fdebbb859d28368ffac31f9b033f4a7bce4a6ab92.png] 

Here, the logic followed is as : In each pair, the second letter-group is obtained by subtracting 2 from the positional value of each letter in the first letter-group.

1) UW − SU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/694dd62d45deb668401fed0a23c13c4c0b35ff2767671ffe04694457475f71ba.png] 

2) OQ − MO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c17ccddbe9a3ee9f563f4c7228b5c9cb1d9bd3ee0e5c8f12f23f0d4f8475ad8b.png] 

3) DF − BD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c606eecb4a0bb3c2ae8e3ceb090a65a48fc007a79c444cf82c21d1d0c78c6d61.png] 

4) IK − FK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7a9b3bf0cb76341199e26a4f143d3530d0261c61ba5529936ab02472f29d095.png] 

 

It is observed that in all the other options, 2 is subtracted from each letter, whereas 'IK − FK' does not follow this pattern.

Therefore, 'IK − FK' does not belong to the group.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
